map-dimensions.description: The total number of tiles in the map grid. Resize Map - Applies the new dimensions to the map. Warning: Shrinking the map may erase existing tiles.

tile-types.description: The type of terrain surface selected for drawing on the map.

tile-legend.description:
• Start - Start of the level, where enemies spawn
  • End - End of the level, where enemies exit
  • Grass - Can build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Snow - Can build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Sand - Can build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Ice - Can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Lava - Can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Path / Path Snow / Path Sand - Enemies walk here, can't build towers
  • Water - Can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Mountains - Can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Air - Empty tile, can't build towers
  • Holy Ground - Can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Burned Ground - Can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Bone 1-4 - Sand decoration, can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Cactus 1-4 - Sand decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Palm 1-4 - Sand decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Spike 1-4 - Snow decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Tree - Grass decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Log 1-2 - Grass decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Well - Grass decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Bush - Grass decoration, can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • FarmLand - Brown soil ground, can build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Hay Field - Wheat field on dirt, can't build towers, doesn't block arrows
  • Snow Tree - Snow decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows
  • Rock 1-4 - Water decoration, can't build towers, blocks arrows

brush-settings.description: The shape and diameter of the brush size used for drawing tiles.

map-title.description: The display name of the level.

starting-coins.description: The amount of gold the player starts with.

starting-lifes.description: The amount of lives the player starts with.

extra-lifes.description: A toggle to enable or disable the 'Extra Life' purchase button.

extra-lifes-prices.description: The price progression for extra lives, in purchase order. The last price will repeat indefinitely. Drag the boxes to reorder them, or use the + button to add more. A negative price pays the player money instead of charging them.

description-text.description: A brief overview or lore of the map shown in the menu as description.

tile-size.description: The fixed pixel dimensions of each map tile. This value is read-only.

difficulty.description: The challenge level of the map, usually represented by ⭐.

price.description: The gold cost required to build the tower.

damage.description: The amount of health removed from an enemy with each hit.

fire-rate.description: The interval between shots measured in milliseconds (e.g., 400ms).

range.description: The detection radius where the tower first targets an enemy.

speed.description: The travel velocity of the tower's projectiles.

sell-price.description: The amount of gold returned when the tower is sold.

color.description: The color of the flags on the tower's building.

enemy-type.description: Specifies which enemy type triggers the shake effect.

shake-duration.description: How long the shake effect lasts once activated.

shake-intensity.description: The strength of the shake effect during its duration.

enemy-type.description: Specifies which enemy type receives the custom damage.

damage.description: The amount of health removed by the specified enemy type when it reaches the tree. Negative values will heal the tree instead of damaging it.

type.description: Identifies the enemy type. Certain game effects may interact with specific types.

skin.description: The visual appearance of enemies in this group. Leave on Random to let each enemy randomly appear as either Golem or Fiery Eye.

count.description: The number of enemies in this spawn group.

health.description: The health value of each individual enemy in this group.

speed.description: The movement speed of enemies in this group.

path.description: The route enemies follow. Example: S1→E1 means they move from Start 1 to Exit 1.

interval.description: The time interval between spawning each enemy in the group.

first-delay.description: The delay before the first enemy of this group appears.

coin-reward.description: The amount of gold awarded for defeating one enemy from this group.

name.description: The display name of the ability shown in the player's UI.

icon.description: The graphical icon or sprite used to represent the ability on the hotbar.

colors_opacity.description: The primary/secondary colors and transparency level (0 to 1.0) for the ability's visual effects and UI elements.

cooldown.description: The time in seconds required for the ability to recharge. Note: Recharge begins immediately upon activation, running concurrently with the duration.

duration.description: The total time the ability's effect remains active on the battlefield.

lava-floor-damage.description: The amount of health removed from enemies at each interval defined by the damage frequency.

lava-floor-damage-frequency.description: The time interval (e.g., 500ms) at which the damage value is applied to enemies standing on the lava.

lava-floor-selection-count.description: The maximum number of map tiles or path segments the player can transform into lava.

towers-fury-damage-multiplier.description: The coefficient applied to tower damage (e.g., 2.0 for double damage).

towers-fury-speed-multiplier.description: The projectile velocity modifier. 1.0 = 0% bonus, 3.0 = +200% speed. Warning: Must be greater than 0 to prevent projectiles from moving backward or breaking.

towers-fury-fire-rate.description: The shot interval modifier. Values below 1.0 increase speed (e.g., 0.85 = +15% faster). Values above 1.0 increase delay (e.g., 1.15 = 15% slower). Warning: Must be greater than 0.
